C-FIND-SELECTION-CLIPBOARD.ApprovalBasis: Owner shortcut regression report and standing focused repair delegation.
C-FIND-SELECTION-CLIPBOARD.IntentSummary: Use one transient store-backed Find visibility flag, shared by the search component. SELECTION_CHANGE prefills a nonempty selection only while Find is closed; while open it preserves the active query/matches and still synchronizes menus. The component clears visibility on teardown. Preserve native clipboard and menu paths. Add failing unit/lifecycle and real keyboard regressions before the implementation.

MustPassCommand.Command: env CI=1 npx --no-install playwright test tests/e2e/keyboard-selection.spec.ts tests/e2e/table- tests/e2e/block-viewer.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=webkit-keyboard --project=webkit-tables --project=webkit-block-viewer

T-001.Title: Preserve active Find across selection and prove native shortcut behavior

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Reproduce lost selection/focus and absent keyboard insertion before the fix; shared visibility closes the selection-to-search feedback. Existing selected-text prefill, menu IPC, exact Markdown/saved state, close/reopen and keyboard/table/perf gates remain covered. Native QA verdict stays pending until explicitly supplied.
